    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1gwdti9",
      "toKey": "n-2jjl7x",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "RHOB being a local area name (condition) rather than an equipment identifier means the alarm location is ambiguous, enabling confusion about where to look for valve states.",
      "status": "supported",

      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If RHOB were a specific compressor, the alarm location would be precise and valve states easier to verify.",

      "evidenceGap": "Need to request the specific version history of equipment-location sheets or crew briefing records for May 20, 2024."
    }

  "decision": {
    "summary": "The focal event (instrument-air low-pressure indication) was caused by a pressure drop at P-R. Contributing conditions include incomplete boundary acceptance (blank work package), ambiguous location naming (RHOB as area, not equipment), and unknown crew awareness of potential routing changes. The primary causal chain is: Pressure Drop -> Alarm Triggered; Boundary Preparation State Enabled Hazard Exposure due to Incomplete Acceptance + Ambiguous Location Context.",
    "evidenceUsed": ["claim-12ce684", "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078", "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6"],
    "unknowns": ["Whether an unrecorded service-routing change occurred (n-i3yme8, n-gkf844)", "Crew awareness of recent changes or valve states (n-1b1mn9d)", "Exact point of interruption in the distribution system vs source (n-1e9h80u)"],
    "alternatives": ["The pressure drop was caused by a transient upstream issue rather than equipment failure", "No unrecorded change occurred; the hazard arose solely from incomplete boundary acceptance and ambiguous location naming"],
    "confidence": 0.75
  },
  "evidenceRequests": [
    "Request claim ID 'claim-1i3o10f' to determine if any engineering disposition or temporary instruction existed for changes between March 2024 and May 20.",
    "Request source passage from document IA-D03_change_and_work_record_requirements.md regarding Section 5.1 on work package records."
  ]
}
